label: PF Backlog 426
title: A6: change classifier + drift guard + language rule + no-undeclared-dep
body: [A6] Governs A1-A7: classify every change; enforce language rule (shipped+sensitive->Go); fail on undeclared runtime dep.

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend existing components/APIs: core/agent_rules.py, core/change_log.py, core/change_registry.py, core/change_spec.py

missing: Fail vs warn initial mode for the language rule
Dependency ecosystems covered by the scanner
context_review.reason: The change registry, guardrails, and rule modules provide all needed substrate. The missing pieces are policy decisions, not technical unknowns; an engineer could implement warn-only mode immediately.

brief.problem: Without governance, shipped/sensitive logic could land in Python or pull undeclared runtime deps, breaking IP protection and packaging.
brief.what_adds: A6 — governance: classify every change; enforce the language rule (shipped+sensitive -> Go); fail on undeclared runtime dependency.
brief.why: Keeps the architecture honest over time; prevents drift back to raw Python.
brief.who_feels: PF platform maintainers, workers, and customers.

objective: A6 — governance: classify every change; enforce the language rule (shipped+sensitive -> Go); fail on undeclared runtime dependency.
acceptance_criteria: gate fails on a Python shipped/sensitive change and on an undeclared runtime dep
approach: Add a classifier that tags each change (shipped/sensitive vs internal) and a gate that fails when the rule is violated or an undeclared runtime dep appears; run in precheck.
verification: gate fails on a Python shipped/sensitive change and on an undeclared runtime dep
